$comment: Text pool for the Salvation/Rededication prayer category.
requests: My husband is far from God. Praying his heart softens.
My dad has never wanted anything to do with church. He is 74 now and his health is slowing him down. I would love for him to know the peace I have found while there is still time.
Our oldest son walked away from his faith in college. He is kind and still calls home every Sunday, but he says he does not believe anymore. We are asking God to draw him back in His time.
I am recommitting my life to Christ. I drifted for a lot of years and I am ready to come home. Praying for strength to stay close to Him this time.
For my sister, who says she has no need for God.
A coworker at my office has started asking me questions about faith over lunch. I want to answer with honesty and grace and not push too hard. Pray that her curiosity keeps growing.
Thinking about getting baptized next month and feeling nervous about standing up in front of everyone. I know it is the right step. Praying for courage and a clear heart.
My best friend from high school lost her mom this year and is angry at God. I do not know what to say most days. Asking the Lord to meet her in that anger and show her He is still good.

I grew up in church but I have not really followed Jesus in almost fifteen years. My wife has been coming to services here for a while and I started tagging along. Something has been stirring in me during worship and I do not fully understand it yet. I would appreciate prayer as I figure out what it means to give my life to Him and not just go through the motions.

Our teenage daughter told us she is not sure she believes in God. We do not want to pressure her and push her further away. Praying for wisdom for us as parents and for her to encounter Jesus for herself.
Lifting up my brother, who has been running from God for a long time. He knows the truth but keeps choosing his own way. I keep praying that he will come to the end of himself and turn back.
My grandson wants to be baptized at camp this summer. Praying that this decision is real and lasting, and that he has good people around him to help him grow.
Recommitting my faith after a really hard season when I stopped praying altogether. I want to read my Bible again and join a small group. Pray I follow through.
Salvation for the young couple who moved in next door.

My mom and I have talked about faith a few times lately, and for the first time she did not change the subject. She even asked if she could come to Easter service with me. Please pray her heart stays open.
We were each sprinkled as babies but never really chose to follow Jesus until this year. Now my husband and I both want to be baptized together. Praying for clarity as we take this step as a couple.
A guy on my crew at work keeps asking me why I am always so calm. I told him a little about my faith and he wants to talk more. Asking God to give me the right words and to work in his heart.

For my son-in-law. He is a wonderful husband to our daughter and a great dad to our grandkids, but he carries a lot of hurt from the church he grew up in back in Texas. He will come to Christmas services but not much else. We are not trying to fix him. We are just asking the Lord to heal those old wounds and show him a church family that is safe and kind.
I prayed to receive Christ at the men's breakfast last week. I am 58 and never thought this would happen to me. Pray that I keep growing and do not slide back into old habits.

My college roommate and I have been friends for twenty years. She has always respected my faith but says it is not for her. Lately her marriage is struggling and she has started asking me to pray for her, which she has never done before. I am praying this is the start of God opening her eyes to how much He loves her, and that I can be a good friend through all of it.
details: This has been on my heart for a long time and I keep bringing it to the Lord.
I know only God can change a heart, so I am trusting Him with this.
Some days I feel hopeful and some days I wonder if anything will ever change.
Our small group has been praying about this too, and it means a lot to know others are standing with us.
I am trying to be patient and let God work in His own timing.
Any prayer for this is so appreciated. It means more than you know.
I would also ask for wisdom and patience for everyone involved.
This matters more to me than almost anything else right now.
answers: Thank you all for praying. God has been moving in ways I did not expect, and I am so grateful.
Update: there has been real progress. It is not finished yet, but the door is open wider than it has been in years.
Nothing has changed that I can see yet, but I have peace that God is working. Thank you for continuing to pray.
Praise God! This prayer has been answered. Thank you for standing with me.
Small steps, but good ones. Keep praying, friends.
Still waiting, still trusting. Your prayers have kept me encouraged.
I have seen a softening I have not seen before. I am thankful and asking for continued prayer.
God answered this in His time and in His way. Thank you for being faithful to pray.
